verdict.rationale: Activepieces supports building custom TypeScript pieces and flows made of triggers/actions, implying some code-level data handling, but the evidence pack never documents an explicit expression/variable-mapping syntax (e.g., {{ }} interpolation) or built-in functions/formulas for transforming data between steps. Missing for 10: explicit docs on step-to-step variable/expression syntax, built-in formula/function library, and examples of mapping outputs from one step into another.
